description: SP ENW - Embedded Capacity Register 2 - 1MW & Above is a dataset listed in Electricity North West open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Electricity North West. Dataset Classification - Open SP ENW - Embedded Capacity Register – Part 2 – 1MW and Above Part 2 of the ECR provides information to electricity network stakeholders on generation and storage resources (rated ≥1MW) that are connected, or accepted to connect, to SP Electricity North West’s distribution network. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Capacity Data. Its keywords are Embedded Capacity Register, ECR, Battery Storage Persona, Distributed Generator Persona, Industrial & Commercial Persona, Large-Scale Generation / Storage Use-case. The portal shows 2026-09-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-enw-open-data-portal.
